stem: A PC beeps and shows nothing on screen after new RAM was added. What is the MOST LIKELY cause?
options: The RAM is not seated correctly
explanation: POST checks memory before video starts. RAM that is not seated well makes the PC beep with no image.
whyWrong: A failed drive gives a boot error after POST.
A corrupt OS fails after POST.
A missing keyboard gives a keyboard error.

stem: Which tool shows the S.M.A.R.T. status of a drive?
explanation: Drive diagnostic tools read the drive's S.M.A.R.T. data. It warns of a failing drive.
whyWrong: Task Manager shows use, not health.

stem: A user has an IP address of 169.254.10.20. What does this mean?
options: The PC could not reach a DHCP server
The PC has a static address
explanation: 169.254.x.x is an APIPA address. Windows gives it when no DHCP server answers.
whyWrong: A static address is set by hand.
DNS problems do not change the address.

stem: Which part of a laser printer melts toner onto the paper?
explanation: The fuser heats and presses the toner into the paper. A bad fuser gives smudged prints.
whyWrong: The transfer roller moves toner to the paper.
